Headline: Front-End Engineer & Team Lead
Summary: My work has taken me from PHP portals and mobile APIs to online course platforms and front-end team leadership. I’m based in Jakarta and now work primarily with React, Next.js, and TypeScript.\nAt PT. Griya Mitra Digital, I develop client portals and admin panels, plan sprint work, and review the team’s pull requests. Working with backend and product teams is part of that day-to-day responsibility, alongside writing and maintaining the front-end code.\nMy personal projects explore two different interests: everyday organization and learning through play. Catat Saja brings notes, tasks, finances, and family health logs together, with end-to-end encryption and sharing. It includes multi-currency finance books with spending charts, and health tracking from body measurements to child growth, medicine reminders, and Gemini helpers for receipts and dictation. Coba Lagi introduces children to coding with visual puzzles and spoken instructions, and is now playable with a controller on Steam Deck.
